title: Explore debit / pinpas account options
intro: A Dutch debit card usually comes with an everyday account. Use these soft CTAs to open official sites, then confirm package fees, card shipping and eligibility yourself — this block is not a ranking.

items.reason: Onboarding: English-first digital Dutch account with a debit card path. Best for: expats who want fast app setup alongside salary and direct debits. Watch-outs: confirm plan tier, physical card costs and whether employers accept your IBAN.

Onboarding: Major Dutch retail bank with a widely used pinpas package. Best for: salary, rent and everyday PIN culture. Watch-outs: compare monthly package fees and English support for your branch region.

Onboarding: Full-service Dutch bank with branch depth when you need help. Best for: newcomers who want a traditional debit stack. Watch-outs: verify package price, card delivery timing and ID/BSN steps on ABN’s site.
Onboarding: Cooperative retail bank with Dutch debit products. Best for: residents who prefer a mainstream pinpas and local presence. Watch-outs: check regional English UX and live tariff PDFs.

Onboarding: App-first EU debit account many expats use for spending. Best for: travel and digital everyday spend while you settle. Watch-outs: confirm salary, rent and Dutch direct-debit fit before treating it as your only account.

Onboarding: Spending and FX companion with a debit-style card. Best for: travel wallets and multi-currency controls beside a Dutch pinpas. Watch-outs: not a substitute for every Dutch payroll or landlord requirement — verify contracts.
